baseline: dd038c6 plus working-tree parallel scans and remote window cache

method.backend: loopback HTTP/1.1 byte-range server, real installed httpfs
method.latency: fixed delay per HTTP request before response headers, not bandwidth shaping
method.first: new in-memory DuckDB instance; filesystem/OS cache state is uncontrolled
method.repeat: identical SQL/URLs on the same connection immediately after first query
method.bytes: response body bytes written by the server; excludes HTTP headers and TCP/TLS overhead
method.cpu: query interval process CPU includes DuckDB and the Python HTTP server
method.cache: external cache snapshots are observable residency, not hit-rate counters; unavailable hit rate remains null
method.scope: no S3/R2 authentication, listing, provider cache, billing, or WAN behavior is measured

method.backend: real MinIO via a Kubernetes port-forward and non-caching counting proxy
method.scope: literal S3 object lists, signed requests; no listing, production data, AWS S3, R2, or cost claims
method.bytes: MinIO response payload bytes forwarded to DuckDB, excludes headers/tunnel overhead
method.timing: includes local proxy and port-forward overhead; not direct-endpoint throughput
method.cache: first=new database; repeat=identical SQL on same connection; hit rate unavailable
method.credentials: environment and ephemeral database secret only; never included in reports
method.control_requests: bucket creation, upload, and cleanup are excluded from query counters
